messages:
Lena (CS): Quick alert 3 ReefWorks onboarding: noticing p95 tail drift since last deploy, now ~410ms vs usual ~180ms. Usage: steady 90 req/s, ~12% >1k tokens. Renewal in 6 weeks, want a preemptive perf play: propose INT8 compact route for non-latency-critical flows + prefix caching. Agree?
Ravi (Eng): Can we get the last 6h perf graph and a sample api call rate? Any errors?
Lena (CS): p95: 410ms (baseline 180ms), p50: 70ms, errors flat. Burst to 150 req/s during ingest window. Customer's internal SLA ~200ms p95 for interactive UI.
Ivy (ML): compact-int8 usually reduces token compute ~1.7x and improves tail latency on long contexts. Risks: slight output variance. Proposal: create 120 prompt eval from their logs, run automatic diff (BLEURT, ROUGE), and do a 48h 3% canary then 10% if green. Also suggest enabling KV prefix cache for repeated system prompts.
Kai (Platform): Routing policy doable. Suggest rule: route fingerprinted "interactive" sessions to standard model; route background/batch to compact-int8. I can stage a canary: weights [{"std":97,"compact":3}] with health checks: p95>220ms for 15m or error +1.5% -> auto rollback. Need model tag and S3 artifact.
deploy-bot: canary-scheduler: available windows tonight 23:00-02:00 UTC and tomorrow 02:00-05:00 UTC. Will schedule on confirmation.
Lena (CS): I'll ask ReefWorks PM for opt-in and to export 120 eval prompts. Also I'll ask product owner about which routes are "interactive" vs "batch".
Ravi (Eng): Ops can run the canary at 23:30 UTC if Ivy posts the eval verdict by 20:00. I'll attach alert thresholds: p95 > 220ms for 10m -> rollback; error delta +2% -> rollback.
Ivy (ML): Eval runner snippet: ```python
prompts = load('reefworks_eval.csv')
res = evaluate_variants(prompts, ['standard-v1','compact-v2-int8'])
print(metrics_summary(res, ['bleurt','latency','fidelity']))
```
Ivy (ML): Suggest runtime params: batching_min=1,batching_max=12,kv_cache_enabled=true,kv_ttl=240s,quant_fallback_tokens=2048.
Kai (Platform): I'll draft the Console policy JSON and upload placeholder artifact path s3://redwood-artifacts/compact-v2-int8/reefworks/2026-03-23 if Ivy gives final artifact name.
Lena (CS): Action items: Lena -> coordinate customer opt-in and collect eval prompts; Ivy -> run eval and post diff; Kai -> prepare canary policy + artifact; Ravi -> schedule canary and hook alerts; deploy-bot -> confirm schedule. Tagging @Ivy (ML) @Kai (Platform) @Ravi (Eng). :eyes:
Ravi (Eng): lgtm, will standby for Ivy's results.
Ivy (ML): on it, will post results here.
Lena (CS): Thanks all 3 will update ReefWorks and recap next steps after canary signup.
